name: Government
scope: U.S. executive branch. Executive/agency acts only: directives, agency offices, agency reporting, declassification/records-release, executive-ordered NDA waivers.
excludes: A statute's enactment (that is Legislative); the executive merely executing it is credited here. Foreign acts (International). Scientific advisory bodies acting as external science (Scientific).
method: First-principles ladder, reality checked afterward. Non-ontological: rungs measure institutional acts (e.g. an admission of custody), never the existence of the underlying thing.
read: The executive has started on almost every front and matured almost none: one settled act, a long partial middle, and the heaviest disclosures unmet. Breadth without depth.
summary: One rung settled (hazard recognition). Everything else is a capability in progress — reporting, intake, the central office, coordination, records release, NDA channels and even the presidential files-release directive all exist but are demonstrably incomplete — and the heaviest acts (raw-data release, independent review board, formal presidential disclosure, custody admission) are unmet.
sourcingQuality: Strong — first-party sources (dni.gov, defense.gov, war.gov, aaro.mil, dodig.mil, archives.gov). Two points rest on named-secondary reporting and are flagged.

rungs.title: Recognized as a hazard
rungs.oneLiner: Executive admits UAP matter for safety/security. e.g. ODNI Preliminary Assessment, June 2021.
rungs.firstPrinciples: First irreversible conceptual shift — UAP enter the operational threat model. A discrete, settled act; you can't be 'more recognized.'
rungs.statusRationale: The executive has affirmatively acknowledged UAP as a flight-safety and possible national-security matter. Settled and irreversible.

sources.label: ODNI Preliminary Assessment on UAP, 25 June 2021

rungs.title: Mandated reporting (executive)
rungs.oneLiner: Personnel ordered to report. Partial: defense directives only, not government-wide.
rungs.firstPrinciples: Changes personnel incentives — non-reporting becomes an auditable failure.
rungs.statusRationale: Mandatory defense reporting exists, but no government-wide duty binds every department through one common process.

sources.label: Deputy Secretary of Defense memo, UAP Assessments, 25 June 2021

rungs.title: Standardized intake
rungs.oneLiner: A reporting mechanism exists. Partial: fragmented, no public intake, quality contested (DoD IG).
rungs.firstPrinciples: Converts anecdote into durable, auditable record.
rungs.statusRationale: Standardized mechanisms exist but are fragmented by reporter type, with no public intake and no government-wide traceable architecture.
rungs.limitation: The 'catch-and-kill' characterization is an analytical judgment, not a sourced fact. The sourced criticism is narrower: the DoD Inspector General found no comprehensive/coordinated DoD UAP approach.

sources.label: AARO Submit-A-Report (multiple intake routes; no general public reporting)
DoD Inspector General — no comprehensive/coordinated DoD UAP approach

rungs.title: Centralized executive office
rungs.oneLiner: AARO exists and is centralized. Partial: DoD IG found no coordinated approach.
rungs.firstPrinciples: A single named body owns the problem; ends agency deflection.
rungs.statusRationale: The office exists and operates, but the DoD Inspector General found no coordinated, overarching approach — the centralized capability is not mature. Under the strict bar (existence alone isn't maturity), Partial.

sources.label: DoD Inspector General evaluation of the DoD UAP approach

rungs.title: Cross-agency coordination
rungs.oneLiner: AARO partnerships + 2026 Governance Board + PURSUE. Partial: not seamless.
rungs.statusRationale: Real interagency activity and recently strengthened, but no complete durable governance architecture is verified, and DoD IG documented fragmentation.

sources.label: PURSUE interagency effort (White House, ODNI, DoE, AARO, NASA, FBI)
June 2026 UAP Governance Board (AP News, attributing ODNI)

rungs.title: Public reporting
rungs.oneLiner: Recurring unclassified reports. Partial: summaries only, data and annexes withheld.
rungs.firstPrinciples: Removes disclosure from internal discretion; claims become publicly checkable on a schedule.
rungs.statusRationale: Recurring unclassified reports are published (the mechanism works), but they are summaries — underlying data, classified annexes, sources/methods and most evidence are withheld. Significant room remains.

sources.label: AARO Congressional/press products index (ODNI 2021–22, AARO FY2023–FY2025)

rungs.title: Structured declassification & records release
rungs.oneLiner: PURSUE + NARA RG 615. Partial: selective source files, no full raw packages.
rungs.firstPrinciples: Identifying records across agencies, reviewing, centralizing and publishing them on a rolling basis. More than aggregate reporting, less than raw-feed release.
rungs.statusRationale: A real, active program releasing selected source files — but curated, selective, brand-new (2026), no full raw packages.

sources.label: NARA UAP Records Collection, Record Group 615 (bulk downloads + metadata)

rungs.title: Release of underlying data / raw feeds
rungs.oneLiner: No complete raw sensor feeds. Loeb council reportedly denied 50 items.
rungs.firstPrinciples: The report is the summary and PURSUE releases source documents; this rung is the raw sensor layer — complete feeds, full-resolution files, metadata, calibration.
rungs.statusRationale: None of that is systematically released. Reportedly, the government's own science council requested ~50 items and had not received them, custodians citing national security.

sources.label: Fox News, July 2026 — Loeb council denied 50 requested items
sources.note: named-secondary via Loeb, not a documented formal denial

rungs.title: Witnesses released from secrecy
rungs.oneLiner: AARO channel overrides NDAs. Partial: no verified general waiver, no public route.
rungs.firstPrinciples: The state actively dismantles its own secrecy so past witnesses can speak. Distinct from reporting.
rungs.statusRationale: Partial holds because the AARO authorized channel is operational — not because of the reported July 2026 general waiver, which has no public text (unnamed officials only). No protected route to speak publicly/to the press.

sources.label: AARO Submit-A-Report — authorized disclosures not subject to individual NDAs

rungs.title: Operational independent review board
rungs.oneLiner: No executive board with independent access, override, or enforcement power.
rungs.firstPrinciples: An independent body (outside holding agencies) with access, override and enforcement power — the executive constitution/operation of such a board.
rungs.statusRationale: No operational executive board exists. The Governance Board is coordination, not adjudication; the Loeb council is external advisory with no override. The Burlison FY2027 vote is a legislative act (see Legislative), not an executive board.

rungs.title: Executive / head-of-state formal disclosure
rungs.oneLiner: Feb 2026 release directive via PURSUE. Partial: a files-release order, not a formal address.
rungs.firstPrinciples: Highest-formality disclosure act (non-ontological — measures formality, not what is disclosed).
rungs.statusRationale: A presidential release directive (19 Feb 2026, via Truth Social, on the official DoW page) was executed by PURSUE — real, so no longer Not yet. But it is a files-release order, not a formal substantive presidential disclosure. Achieved would require the President formally disclosing to the nation.

sources.label: Presidential UAP release directive, executed via PURSUE (official DoW page)

rungs.title: Acknowledged custody of materials & biologics
rungs.oneLiner: No official admission of held materials. Measures the admission, not the existence.
rungs.firstPrinciples: Measures the public admission of holding materials/biologics — not their existence. Stays 'not yet' permanently if no admission occurs, which is correct.
rungs.statusRationale: No qualifying public executive admission of custody. Only sworn allegations exist; AARO's own record reports no verifiable evidence of held exotic material.

sources.label: AARO Historical Record Report Vol. I (no verifiable evidence of extraterrestrial technology access)

crossTrackNotes: A statute's vote is Legislative; the executive executing it is Government. The Loeb-chaired Science Advisory Council is external/scientific (Scientific), not Government; only the interagency Governance Board is a Government-track act.

excludedClaims.claim: Immaculate Constellation — an alleged unacknowledged special-access UAP program
excludedClaims.reason: Entered into the Congressional Record on 13 Nov 2024 (Rep. Mace), so the filing is a verifiable official act — but the content is uncorroborated: the DoD stated it has no record of such a program, and 19 months on no government source has confirmed it, nor does its name appear in any PURSUE release. Shown because it is officially recorded and widely known; the record attests the deposit, not the program.
